sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: This page describes how Aurelis collects, uses and protects the personal information of people who visit this website or place an order with us.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you place an order or contact us, we may collect your name, email address, shipping address, phone number and order details. Payment card details are collected and processed directly by our third party payment processor and are not stored on our servers. We may also collect basic browser and device information through cookies and analytics tools.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to process and ship your order, respond to customer service requests, send order updates, send marketing emails if you have opted in, and improve the content and performance of this website.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This website uses cookies to keep items in your shopping cart and to understand how visitors use the site. You can disable cookies through your browser settings, though some parts of the site may not function correctly without them.

sections.heading: Sharing Your Information
sections.body: We share order information with shipping carriers and payment processors only to the extent necessary to fulfil and process your order. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain order and customer records for as long as needed to meet accounting, tax and legal obligations.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of the personal information we hold about you by contacting us at [contact email].

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: This website is not directed at children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a new effective date.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy, please contact us at [contact email].

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: These terms govern your use of this website and any purchase you make from Aurelis. By placing an order, you agree to the terms described on this page.

sections.heading: Products and Availability
sections.body: Because our items are handmade, small variations in color, size and texture may occur between the product photos and the item you receive. Product availability may change without notice.

sections.heading: Custom Orders
sections.body: Custom and made to order items are final sale unless the item arrives defective or damaged. Production timelines are estimates and are not guaranteed.

sections.heading: Pricing and Payment
sections.body: All prices are listed in [currency]. Payment is due in full at the time of ordering. We reserve the right to correct any pricing errors shown on the site.

sections.heading: Shipping
sections.body: Estimated shipping timelines and costs are shown at checkout. Once an order has been handed to the shipping carrier, Aurelis is not responsible for delays caused by the carrier.

sections.heading: Returns and Exchanges
sections.body: Please see our Returns page for details on which items are eligible for return or exchange. Custom and made to order items are not eligible for return unless defective.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: All designs, photographs, illustrations and written content on this website are the property of Aurelis and may not be copied or reused without written permission.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: This website and its products are provided as is. Aurelis is not liable for any indirect or incidental damages arising from the use of this site or its products, beyond the purchase price paid.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of [State or Country].

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of this website after changes are posted means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about these terms, please contact us at [contact email].
